name: myssl
description: Deep analysis of the TLS configuration of any public server: protocols, cipher suites, certificate chain, known weaknesses and a letter grade

scripts.check:syntax: node --check public/app.js && node --check public/i18n.js && node --check server/index.js && node --check server/scan.js && node --check server/tls-probe.js && node --check server/suites.js && node --check server/cert.js && node --check server/http-probe.js && node --check server/dns-probe.js && node --check server/vulns.js && node --check server/grade.js && node --check server/asn1.js
scripts.test: npm run check:syntax && npm run check:i18n && npm run test:unit && npm run smoke
